An '''earth orb''' is a glass orb that has been charged at the [[Obelisk of Earth]] by using the [[Charge Earth Orb]] spell, requiring 60 [[Magic]], on the obelisk. The spell requires an [[unpowered orb]], 30 [[earth rune]]s, and 3 [[cosmic rune]]s, yielding 70 Magic [[experience]]. The Earth Obelisk is located in the [[Edgeville Dungeon]], south of the [[black demon]]s beyond the [[poison spider]]s and [[Chronozon]].

An earth orb can be used on a [[battlestaff]], requiring 58 [[Crafting]], yielding an [[earth battlestaff]] and 112.5 Crafting experience.
